title: Claim output annotates the granted-worktree execution location
action: Add a claim-time execution-location annotation (plan.md C1, decisions D1/D2/D6). Shared helper in the cells module: given the main store root and the claimed cell's feature, resolve the feature's granted worktree via crate::hooks::write_guard::find_feature_worktree_grant (crate-visible via write_guard/mod.rs pub(crate) use; three-state enum Found/NotFound/Unresolvable at hook_local.rs:637-644). Found -> annotate; NotFound and Unresolvable -> no annotation (fail open). In run_claim (handlers_write.rs:602-646), after claim_cell_from_flags_ex succeeds, append one suffix line to the success emit text naming the worktree root: execution runs from a session rooted there, and a subagent dispatched from main inherits main's cwd and cannot write into the worktree; add worktree_root to the emitted JSON object. Same suffix line and worktree_root field for run_claim_next's success output (handlers_select.rs:658-843, result object ok/cell/claim). NO refusal path, NO candidate_ok change, NO change to any refusal string or to NO_APPROVED_WORK. Never call std::env::set_current_dir in tests; the annotation must not depend on acting cwd. Tests extend wf_worktree_fixture (cells/tests.rs:4644): grant present -> line + field on both claim and claim-next; no grant -> both absent; unresolvable grant entry -> both absent as a named fail-open case. If any existing test pins the exact full success text, update it in this cell.

truths: cells claim and cells claim-next success output name the granted worktree root when one exists for the claimed cell's feature, in text and as worktree_root in JSON
No claim/claim-next refusal or skip semantics changed; refusal strings byte-identical
Unresolvable grant entries fail open with a test naming that case
No test uses set_current_dir; full suite green

trace.outcome: Claim/claim-next annotate success output with the granted worktree root, fail-open on unresolvable grants
